prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a low-speed head-on collision claim. Injury: concussion. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1404; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened for a low-speed head-on collision on a two-lane road. Insured vehicle and third-party vehicle both sustained front-end damage. Claimant reports neck stiffness and headache at the scene and was transported to urgent care. Police report requested. Claimant is not represented by counsel at this time.

Entry 2: Spoke with claimant by phone. Claimant describes ongoing dizziness, light sensitivity, and difficulty concentrating since the impact. Provider notes a diagnosis of concussion with recommendation for rest and follow-up imaging. Requested medical records and signed authorization. Explained the claims process and that claimant may choose to consult an attorney at any point.

Entry 3: Received treatment records from urgent care. Confirmed concussion diagnosis and work restrictions for two weeks. Reviewed vehicle appraisal; repair estimate is in progress with the body shop. Claimant asked whether medical bills will be covered under the policy's bodily injury provisions. Advised that coverage is determined after the medical review is complete.

Entry 4: Follow-up call with claimant. Symptoms have partially improved but headaches continue in the afternoons. Claimant has a neurology appointment scheduled and will forward the report once available. Confirmed rental vehicle arrangements and reminded claimant to keep all receipts. Claimant still has not retained legal representation.

Entry 5: Police report received and reviewed. Report indicates the other driver crossed the center line during a passing maneuver, and citation was issued. Liability assessment is in progress pending statements from both drivers and the neurology report. Diary set for review in thirty days. Supervisor notified that the claim involves a bodily injury component.
